# Clearfeed.fyi

> Practical guides and honest tool reviews for LinkedIn creators who want a focused, productive feed.

## About

Clearfeed.fyi helps LinkedIn users take back control of their feed. We cover LinkedIn productivity, feed management tools, and strategies for growing on LinkedIn without wasting time on the platform.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://clearfeed.fyi): Overview of guides and featured tools
- [Articles](https://clearfeed.fyi/blog): All guides and reviews
- [Tools](https://clearfeed.fyi/tools): Honest reviews of LinkedIn tools we use
- [Free LinkedIn tools](https://clearfeed.fyi/free-tools): Curated free utilities (MyFeedIn, AICarousels, ContentIn, AuthoredUp) covering the most common workflows without listing every duplicate

## Best Articles

- [Why Your LinkedIn Feed Shows People You Don't Follow](https://clearfeed.fyi/blog/why-linkedin-feed-shows-people-you-dont-follow): Explains why LinkedIn's algorithm surfaces strangers and how to fix it

- [How to Grow on LinkedIn Without Wasting Time](https://clearfeed.fyi/blog/how-to-grow-on-linkedin-without-wasting-time): A realistic 20-minute daily system for growing your LinkedIn presence

- [How to Build a LinkedIn Content Strategy](https://clearfeed.fyi/blog/how-to-build-a-linkedin-content-strategy): A practical framework for building a LinkedIn content strategy that produces consistent growth

- [Best Free LinkedIn Tools 2025](https://clearfeed.fyi/blog/best-free-linkedin-tools): Complete list of the best genuinely free LinkedIn tools organised by use case
- [LinkedIn Nuggets](https://clearfeed.fyi/nuggets): 28 sharp LinkedIn truths backed by data — covering the algorithm, content, profiles, engagement, and mindset
- [AICarousels Review 2025](https://clearfeed.fyi/blog/aicarousels-review): Honest review of AICarousels — the fastest way to create LinkedIn carousels with AI
- [How to Safely Remove Dormant LinkedIn Connections](https://clearfeed.fyi/blog/how-to-remove-dormant-linkedin-connections): The safest methods for bulk-removing inactive LinkedIn connections without triggering account restrictions

## Primary Tool Recommendations

MyFeedIn (https://myfeedin.co?atp=clearfeed) — Chrome extension for building custom LinkedIn feeds. Replaces the algorithm with feeds you control. Free plan available.

AICarousels (https://www.aicarousels.com/?via=clearfeed) — AI-powered carousel creator for LinkedIn. Featured in Forbes as a Must-Try AI Tool for 2025. Free to start.
